architecture: Identical shared CNN-GRU32 network in all arms, plus Linear32->7 auxiliary activity head present even in control (weight zero), 14536 parameters; same initialization and shuffle seeds across arms.
person_weight_policy: For each actual fit subset only, per-window weight=N/(P*n_person), mean1, exactly equal total N/P contribution per person. Uniform shuffled minibatches; only FoG BCE weighted. No class balancing, clipping, resampling or activity weighting.
activity_policy: TRAIN current-window majority activity 1..7 -> target0..6; unlabeled0/mixed ignored. CrossEntropy(valid targets)*0.2 added only in activity_aux. No activity truth as input or runtime veto; outputs remain binary FoG. Checkpoint people supply only FoG targets, not activity targets.
checkpoint_policy: Reuse previous frozen TRAIN14 nested personnel plans. All arms checkpoint on unweighted FoG BCE plus existing kernel L2 only; excludes person weights and auxiliary loss. Reinitialize on all outer fit people for selected epochs, score outer held-out people.
deployment_policy: Median three inner best epochs, fresh TRAIN14 fit; threshold uses TRAIN pooled OOF F1/BA/higher cutoff. MODEL_LOCK before separate VALIDATION evaluation. No VALIDATION refit or tuning; no new TEST windows/scores.
development_success_gate: Each candidate vs freshly retrained control on same VALIDATION windows: higher F1, no greater false alarm seconds, no lower FoG-time recall. No automatic default replacement even if a gate passes.
replay_policy: Reuse author CNN reference report/selected_cases.json validation case, no favorable case reselection.
search_budget: Three isolated arms, one optimizer setting/seed per fold. Do not combine balancing+auxiliary, search lambda, retry seeds, tune on VALIDATION, alter default model/controller or implement A2 direction/intent.
